reference.title: tagdictionary-And
reference.shortdesc: And is one of several possible validity conditions properties. If all of the specified criteria are present in the queried object, the parent definition's tag(s) may be applied.

section.p: For example, you can drag an AndRule onto the rule definitions of a smart tag dictionary. Then, drag the And condition (or other conditions) under the condition And for that rule, as shown here.
The validity conditions are located in the tagdictionary palette.
